title: 第一千六百一十九章 主动出击第一千六百一十八章 赶赴战场
content_zh:
刘长旭通过大阵水镜凝神观察着战场的全貌，目光扫过那如潮水般涌向护岛大阵的低阶海妖。
它们前仆后继地冲向大阵光幕，虽被阵法仙力冻结成冰雕，却也让大阵光幕的亮度悄无声息的黯淡下去。
他心中一动，当即识破了海妖的伎俩：对方显然是想用无穷无尽的低阶海妖充当“消耗品”，一点点榨干大阵的能量，打破其运转平衡；待阵法能量不足或出现防御破绽，再让高阶妖修趁虚而入，发动总攻。
而在识破了海妖的算计后，刘长旭立刻传令召集刘家高层，以及防区内所有合体期及以上的修士，齐聚大阵水镜前议事。
需要补充的是，他负责的这片防区本就部署了上千万修士，单看数量堪称雄厚。
可当众人齐聚，刘长旭清点人数时，心头却忍不住沉了下去：合体期修士仅有三十五人，大乘期更是只有两位，且都是战力偏弱的大乘初期女修。
这般高阶战力配置，与千万修士的基数相比，实在太过悬殊，想要以此顶住海妖后续的总攻，恐怕非常艰难。
怪不得，白雪凤对他的到来这么欢喜呢！原来是因为这个。
他深吸一口气，压下心中的失望，目光扫过在场众人，沉声道：
“诸位也看到了，海妖正以低阶炮灰消耗大阵能量，其心昭然若揭。若等大阵出现防御漏洞，必然引来灾难性后果，因此，唯有主动破局，方能扭转颓势。”
他指着水镜中几处海妖冲锋最密的区域道：
“这些地方的低阶海妖最为集中，也是消耗大阵能量最快的节点。我意带你们，以雷霆手段清剿这些地方的海妖，以减轻大阵的压力，不知诸位可有异议？”
在场的修士听了面面相觑，他们没有想到，刘长旭竟然要带他们出阵作战，这让他们忧心不已。
一位身穿白衣，身姿绝美的大乘期女修，拱手道：
“前辈所言极是，只是大阵之外太过凶险，一旦遭遇高阶海妖突袭，怕是会遭遇严重损失……”
刘长旭听了，并没有因为女修的质疑而恼怒，而是耐心的解释道：
“如果出阵作战，诸位尽管杀妖，本座会帮诸位阻击那些高阶海妖。”
众人见他态度坚决，纷纷表示同意。
刘长旭当即开始分派任务，为了让众修放心，他命妻子黄玉蔷、黄玉薇两姐妹负责统领这支队伍。
原本对刘长旭心存不满的众修，见他竟让自己的两位妻子也加入这般凶险的行动，心中那点怨念顿时烟消云散，反倒生出几分敬佩。

然而做出部署后，刘长旭并未立刻下令出阵，而是紧盯着水镜中兽潮的动向，耐心等待最佳时机。
他心中清楚，众修的担忧并非多余。此刻海妖虽以低阶炮灰为主，但阵外仍有高阶妖修游弋窥伺，稍有不慎便可能陷入重围。
为了将伤亡风险降到最低，刘长旭对出击时机的考量必须慎之又慎，每一个细节都要反复推演。
content_en:
Liu Changxu observed the entire battlefield through the large water mirror, and his eyes swept across the low-level sea monsters that were rushing towards the island protection formation like a tide.
They rushed towards the large array of light curtains one after another. Although they were frozen into ice sculptures by the magic power of the formation, the brightness of the large array of light curtains was dimmed silently.
His heart moved, and he immediately saw through the Kraken's trick: the opponent obviously wanted to use endless low-level Kraken as "consumables" to drain the energy of the formation bit by bit and break its operating balance; when the energy of the array was insufficient or there were defense flaws, the high-level demon cultivators would take advantage of it and launch a general attack.
After seeing through the Siren's plan, Liu Changxu immediately summoned the senior officials of the Liu family and all the monks in the defense area who were in the integration stage and above to gather in front of the large water mirror to discuss matters.
What needs to be added is that the defense area he is responsible for already has tens of millions of monks deployed, which can be considered a strong number alone.
But when everyone gathered together and Liu Changxu counted the number of people, his heart couldn't help but sink: there were only thirty-five monks in the combined stage, and there were only two in the Mahayana stage, and they were all early-stage Mahayana female cultivators with weak combat power.
Compared with the base of tens of millions of monks, such a high-level combat power configuration is too disparate. It may be very difficult to withstand the subsequent general attack of the Kraken.
No wonder Bai Xuefeng was so happy about his arrival! It turned out to be because of this.
He took a deep breath, suppressed the disappointment in his heart, glanced at everyone present, and said in a deep voice:
"Everyone has also seen that the Kraken is consuming the energy of the formation with low-level cannon fodder, and its intention is clear. If there is a defensive loophole in the formation, it will inevitably lead to catastrophic consequences. Therefore, the only way to reverse the situation is to take the initiative to break the situation."
He pointed to several areas in the water mirror where the sea monsters charged the most and said:
"The low-level sea monsters in these places are the most concentrated, and they are also the nodes that consume the energy of the formation the fastest. I intend to lead you to use thunder to eliminate the sea monsters in these places to reduce the pressure on the formation. I wonder if you have any objections?"
The monks present looked at each other in shock. They did not expect that Liu Changxu would lead them out to fight, which made them worried.
A beautiful Mahayana female cultivator wearing white clothes raised her hands and said:
"What the senior said is absolutely true, but it's just too dangerous outside the large formation. Once a high-level sea monster attacks, I'm afraid we will suffer serious losses..."
After Liu Changxu heard this, he was not angry because of the female cultivator's doubts, but patiently explained:
"If you go out to fight, you can kill monsters, but I will help you stop those high-level sea monsters."
Seeing his firm attitude, everyone agreed.
Liu Changxu immediately began to assign tasks. In order to reassure the cultivators, he appointed his wife Huang Yuqiang and Huang Yuwei to lead the team.
The cultivators who were originally dissatisfied with Liu Changxu saw that he actually let his two wives participate in such a dangerous action. The resentment in their hearts immediately disappeared, and instead they felt a bit of admiration.
However, after making the deployment, Liu Changxu did not immediately order the formation. Instead, he closely watched the movement of the beast tide in the water mirror and patiently waited for the best opportunity.
He knew in his heart that the concerns of the cultivators were not unnecessary. Although the sea monsters are mainly low-level cannon fodder at the moment, there are still high-level monster cultivators wandering outside the formation and watching, and they may fall into a tight siege if they are not careful.
In order to minimize the risk of casualties, Liu Changxu must carefully consider the timing of the attack, and must repeatedly deduce every detail.
